basics.summary: Healthcare operations and tooling program leader with 12+ years across RCM delivery, business analysis, process redesign, analytics, automation, and founder-led product work. Breaks ambiguous business problems into workflows, dependencies, tradeoffs, and measurable delivery plans. Designs governed internal tools and data systems using SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, and AI-assisted workflows, with strong emphasis on adoption, controls, documentation, and operational outcomes.
